== History ==
The date of foundation is unknown. In the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}'', it is listed as a small state-supported shrine; in the ''{{ill|Izumi Province Divine Name Register|ja|国内神名帳|qid=Q11420490}}'' and ''{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Mino no Kuni Jinmyōki}}'', it appears as "Junior Fifth Rank Lower Grade, Tai Myōjin." It was also called "Tai-no-miya."
